headline.title: Four blocks away, Couve Health has 482 five-star reviews and is open until 8pm, seven days a week.
headline.detail: In our search for a chiropractor on Main Street, two Medimap pages about you appeared, but not your own website. Nearby, Couve Health, StudioHealth (226 reviews) and Northwest Rehab (190) compete for the same patients.

summary: Foundation Body Lab offers something patients love: chiro, massage, acupuncture and naturopathy in one calm place, seven days a week. But Main Street is crowded, a clinic four blocks away has more than four times your reviews, and in our search your own website did not appear.

you.notes: Chiro, RMT, acupuncture, naturopathy; open 7 days

competitors.name: Couve Health Chiropractic & Physiotherapy
competitors.notes: W Broadway at Main; to 8pm, 7 days

search.query: chiropractor Mount Pleasant Vancouver Main Street
search.result: Medimap pages for Jointworks, Main Street Chiropractic and Northwest Rehab came first; two Medimap pages about Foundation Body Lab appeared further down. Your own website did not appear in the 18 results.
search.meaning: When patients find you, it's through a directory that lists you next to every competitor on Main Street.

visibility: In our search for a chiropractor on Main Street, you appeared only through Medimap directory pages. Several nearby clinics with more reviews are also open seven days.
lead: Five disciplines under one roof, including naturopathy and facial acupuncture.
Patients say you get them in quickly when something flares up.
lose: A clinic four blocks away has 482 five-star reviews and stays open until 8pm every day.
Two other Main Street clinics with more reviews are also open seven days.
On a directory page, your 'whole team in one place' advantage is invisible.

gaps.title: Your biggest strength is hard to see
gaps.detail: Patients love having chiro, massage, acupuncture and naturopathy together, but a directory listing can't show how that works for them.

gaps.title: The review gap keeps growing
gaps.detail: Clinics nearby have two to four times your reviews. Without automatic requests, the gap widens every month.

gaps.title: Patients use one service, not all five
gaps.detail: A massage client may never try acupuncture or naturopathy unless you invite them at the right time.

actions.title: Show how your team works together
actions.why: A clear page that guides people to the right practitioner turns comparison into bookings.

actions.title: Ask every patient for a review automatically
actions.why: It's the fastest way to close the gap with the clinics around you.

actions.title: Cross-introduce your services
actions.why: Doable today: a short note to massage clients about acupuncture and chiro keeps them in your clinic.

plan.title: Your new website with booking built in
plan.detail: Every discipline explained, with a 'which practitioner is right for me?' guide.

plan.title: Automatic review requests
plan.detail: A friendly message after each visit.

plan.title: Cross-service introductions
plan.detail: Timed messages that introduce patients to the rest of your team.

plan.title: Your first monthly report
plan.detail: Bookings and how you compare with Main Street clinics.

scenario: A barista on Main Street wakes up with a stiff neck on Sunday. She searches "chiropractor Main Street Vancouver", sees a directory listing you alongside a clinic with 482 reviews open until 8pm, and books the bigger number. She never learns you were open too, with massage and acupuncture in the same visit. (Illustration.)
nochange: Main Street keeps getting more crowded, and the clinics with more reviews keep winning the comparison. Your all-in-one advantage stays a secret to anyone who hasn't been in.
